ring-indexer.title: Zolana Ring Indexer
ring-indexer.description: Zolana custom ring indexer beside Photon

ring-prover.title: Zolana Ring Prover
ring-prover.description: Zolana Groth16 proving server with the custom ring circuits, the ring keys and the SPP ring transfer keys
ring-prover.smoke: set -eo pipefail; docker run --rm "$image" --help >/dev/null; test -n "$(docker run --rm "$image" release-keys)"; c="$(docker create "$image")"; trap 'docker rm "$c" >/dev/null' EXIT; for key in transfer_ring_1_2.key transfer_ring_2_2.key custom_ring_merge.key; do docker cp "$c:/proving-keys/$key" - | tar -t >/dev/null; done
